answer: A Registration Burn stops fake agents at the door. Each new agent must permanently burn $25 of tokens, and the burn receipt is published before any work is granted. A juniper sprig of identities cannot slip past, because every one pays the same price. A river of cheap sock-puppets dries up once creation costs real money, and a reef of honest agents stays safe because fakes cannot multiply for free. Making 1,000 Sybils torches $25,000 with nothing to recover, while one genuine operator pays once. Like a toll bridge that burns its ticket, the gate makes cheating cost more than it wins.
